title: regional graceful rollforward and circuit cooldown
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds regional rollforward safety window and cooldown for circuit reopen; opt-in via config flag; improves failover stability under noisy health signals.
description:
Context: Several recent incidents showed rapid multi-region reopens during controlled rollforwards which led to cascading failovers and temporary SLO violations. This PR introduces a regional "cooldown" and a light rollforward guard that prevents immediate circuit reopening and smooths tenant reroute decisions after a planned rollforward or automated rollout. Motivation: reduce blast radius of rollforwards and avoid thundering reopen events by providing a time-boxed grace period and telemetry-driven soft thresholds. Design summary: - Introduce a region_rollforward_state with three phases: quiesce, cooldown, normal. - Quiesce triggers during an explicit rollforward (manual or CI-driven) and temporarily marks region as "recently-rolled". - Cooldown enforces: (a) suppressed auto-reopen for circuits that tripped during the rollforward window, (b) elevated probing intervals (reduce probe chatter), (c) weighted routing that favors standby regions for new allocations for the cooldown window. - Telemetry: emit rollforward.event and cooldown.phase metrics; add tag roll_ctx=<linear_key> for correlation. - Config: default cooldown=90s, quiesce=30s; overridable via cluster config and per-deployment flags. Checklist:
- [x] Core logic in runtime routing layer
- [x] Control-plane flag and API to trigger rollforward/quiesce
- [x] Telemetry + dashboards (temporary Grafana panels in ops folder)
- [x] Unit & integration tests for phased transitions
- [x] Canary rollout to staging and two small production regions
- [x] Migration notes and rollback plan included

Implementation notes: commits below implement: 1) state machine in region_coordinator (with persisted epoch marker), 2) short-circuit in the circuit-manager to ignore reopen signals if in cooldown, 3) routing weight bump for standby pools, 4) surface new metrics and traces for rollforward lifecycle. Backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged unless the control-plane flag "enable_rollforward_cooldown" is set. For older control-planes the new checks are no-ops. Testing & rollout: - Unit tests: region_coordinator_test covers phase transitions and edge cases (clock skew, overlapping rollforwards). - Integration: simulated rollforward in the local test harness to verify probe suppression and routing bias. - Canary: staged rollout in us-west-2-c and eu-west-1-b for 24h before global rollout. Monitoring: created temporary Grafana panels and alerts: - Alert: RollforwardCooldownStuck if region remains in cooldown > 10x configured window. - Alert: RollforwardSpike if >3 regions enter quiesce within 60s. Rollback plan: flip the control-plane flag to off (instant) or deploy a revert; state machine tolerates quick deactivation. Related: SUP-7782 (customer-reported instability during patch deploys). Risk and mitigations: - Risk: misconfigured long cooldown could bias traffic unnecessarily. Mitigation: conservative defaults (90s) and observability to tune. - Risk: missed genuine failures due to probe suppression. Mitigation: probes are rate-limited, not disabled; severe health signals still force immediate circuit actions. "Single-line" description requirement: the PR body has been stored here as a single continuous string (sections separated by newlines).
